name: @ohmywind/mobile
description: Thin Capacitor shell around ohmywind.fr for Android (iOS later). No native screens: the shell loads the live web app. The shell version lives in android/app/build.gradle.

scripts.build:dev: npm run sync:dev && npm run apk
scripts.build:local: npm run sync:local && npm run apk
scripts.build:prod: npm run sync:prod && npm run apk
